article.body: The UK Defence Innovation (UKDI) has updated its Standard Terms and Conditions for funding, contracts, and intellectual property rights. This change affects companies applying for funding through UKDI. The updated terms and conditions are effective from September 23, 2026, as stated in the UKDI Standard Terms and Conditions document published by the Defence and Security Accelerator. The specifics of the changes are not explicitly detailed in the provided intelligence.
